1.1.3.4-f10.accuracy_reason: Appetitus caninus or fames canina is the standard old medical name for morbid, ravenous hunger, i.e. bulimia.

1.1.3.4-f14.accuracy_reason: Aetius's Tetrabiblos is divided into four tetrabibloi of four sermones each, and Tetrab. 2 serm. 2 cap. 9 is on melancholy.

1.1.3.4-f15.accuracy_reason: Mirach (from Arabic marāqq) means the abdominal wall or lower belly in medieval Latin medicine, so mirachialis melancholy is the abdominal (hypochondriacal) kind.
